title: Describe an actual completed-root retirement accurately in the own-clear success notice
outcome: A clear that retires a retained local name says that it retired the name; an already-retired binding keeps the read-only already-ended notice.
acceptance: A successful own-clear that performs canonical reconciliation and removes a retained completed selection reports that retirement without saying no name changed; repeat already-ended calls retain the read-only lifecycle result.
Behavioral tests distinguish the first retirement from a repeated no-op without changing producer authority or weakening stale-image refusals.
